summary: The FBI is still investigating a suspected break-in at its national crime database. The Director of National Intelligence has now publicly confirmed the probe but gave no details. Stocks and Bitcoin held their rebound, and I found no trading halts. No official source links the FBI and USDA incidents.

events.title: FBI probes suspected breach of its national crime database
events.impact: Police use NCIC for warrant and missing-person checks. Reports do not say if it went down or if records were copied. The FBI declined to comment to the AP.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. NEW: the Director of National Intelligence said Sunday the FBI is probing the source and scope but gave no details. No attacker named. No official link to the September ShinyHunters case.

events.title: USDA cyber incident hit farm payment and loan systems
events.impact: Farm loan, payment and conservation systems were shut down so passwords could be reset. An official said most systems should return by Friday. I found no notice of full restoration yet.
events.stated_cause: A USDA under secretary called it a cyberthreat and said no personal data was lost. USDA has not named an attacker or given a full public account.

events.title: US stocks surge Monday after worst week in years
events.impact: Price check: S&P 500 closed up 4.73% at 7,237 and Nasdaq up 6.51%, per Yahoo Finance and Bloomberg. Friday's close was 6,910. Futures are slightly higher tonight. No trading halts found.
events.stated_cause: Reports tie the rebound to Nvidia bringing back Jensen Huang as CEO. The earlier drop was tied to AI worries. No technical fault or cyber attack reported.

events.title: Bitcoin near 61-63K USD, up on the day, down about 5% on the week
events.impact: Price check: CoinGecko 60,871; OKX 61,245; Kraken 61,949; Coinbase 62,768; Coinglass 63,443. Quotes differ by timing but agree on direction. No exchange outage found.
events.stated_cause: No technical or attack cause reported. Moves track the stock selloff and rebound and Fed worries.

events.title: Tanker attacks near Strait of Hormuz at highest level of the war
events.impact: Three tankers were hit Friday and Saturday, with fires and no deaths reported. Iranian state media claims more mine strikes, not confirmed. Brent fell about 2.6% to near 89 USD. US Treasury added Iran oil sanctions.
events.stated_cause: Nobody has claimed the projectile hits. A maritime risk firm says Iranian involvement is likely. Iran says tankers hit mines; that is unconfirmed.

events.title: Delta computer outage delayed flights; crews used manual math
events.impact: About 1,654 of 5,000 Delta flights were delayed Sunday. Crews used manual workarounds while automation was restored. No Delta problem shows in the FAA feed now.
events.stated_cause: Delta blamed its weight and balance system. The FAA said the delays were not related to air traffic control systems. No official source reports a cyber attack.

events.title: FAA ground stop at Las Vegas airport for staffing
events.impact: The FAA feed shows a ground stop at Las Vegas until 10:30 pm Pacific, plus a delay averaging 35 minutes. LaGuardia is closed overnight except helicopters under a notice.
events.stated_cause: The FAA lists staffing for the Las Vegas ground stop. No equipment failure or cyber attack is listed.

events.title: Shopify checkout reportedly down for some users
events.impact: User reports rose around 12:41 p.m. ET Monday. Size and length are unknown. I found no wire report and no newer update.

events.title: Cloudflare status page shows degraded performance
events.impact: Cloudflare's status feed lists Sites and Services as degraded since Monday and Amsterdam under maintenance. No wire report of a wide outage.
events.stated_cause: Unknown. Cloudflare gave no cause in the data I saw.

events.title: CISA adds two more actively exploited flaws to its catalog
events.impact: Covers Project MONAI MONAI Label and N-able Mail Assure. This is a routine notice, not an emergency directive.
events.stated_cause: CISA cites active exploitation. It names no attacker and does not tie the flaws to the USDA or FBI incidents.

connection_assessment.reasoning: The FBI database case and the USDA case are both government cyber incidents. Nobody has named an attacker or a cause for either, and no official source links them. Delta blamed its own weight system, the Las Vegas stop is for staffing, and the stock and oil moves have market causes.
connection_assessment.would_change_my_mind: An official statement blaming the same attacker or company, or several big systems failing at the same moment, would make me think they are connected.

alert.reason: No new confirmed event shows a link or a wide failure. Level is unchanged.

prep_note: No action needed for most people. If you rely on USDA farm programs, check your local office before the December 11 enrollment deadline. Keep a backup way to pay, and keep some cash on hand. Use official sites for updates on the FBI and USDA incidents.
